data.title: Locksmith invoice for door opening, €266.56
data.summary: Schlüsseldienst Beispiel 24h invoices €266.56 (incl. 19% VAT) for opening your apartment door on 6 December 2026 at 21:40. Payment is requested within one week after you receive the invoice.
data.explanation: This is a bill from a locksmith for opening your apartment door without damaging the lock. It consists of door opening (€129.00), a Sunday/holiday/night surcharge (€60.00) and call-out fee (€35.00), plus VAT. The invoice shows no date, so the one-week payment period runs from when you received it; the app shows the deadline once the receipt date is known. Pay to the IBAN given, quoting the invoice number. If the surcharges or prices seem too high compared with what was agreed, ask the locksmith or a consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale) before paying.

warnings: The invoice has no invoice date, so the payment period depends on when you received it.
Emergency locksmith invoices are sometimes overpriced; check that the night/Sunday surcharge (€60.00) matches what was agreed at the time, especially as the job began at 21:40.
